title: Simple Pulao (Basmati Rice Cooked in Stock)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: The author's favorite rice: basmati cooked in stock with whole spices. Serve with meat or vegetable dishes, never with daal.

steps.action: Rinse in a large bowl until the water runs almost clear (removes starch that makes grains stick); drain well:
Heat in a large pot over high, 2 min:
Add and stir about 1 min, until the cumin darkens slightly:
Add, stir well, and bring to a boil (stir until any bouillon cubes dissolve):
items: 2¾ cups beef stock (650 ml; chicken or vegetable ok; cubes fine, but measure the water exactly)
1 tsp salt, only if the stock is unsalted

steps.action: Cover tightly; cook on low (2/10) exactly 23 min. Turn off heat and rest covered 5 min. Never lift the lid while cooking.
